tools.description: Basic QC on an image nobody has QC'd, without a model: the Artifact Detector (tissue folds -- also ones that come or go between imaging cycles -- tears, debris, saturated pixels) written at its default thresholds as automatic, unreviewed regions, and DNA retention where the image has a DNA channel per cycle and a mask; the cells inside are excluded. A job (job_wait). An image with a QC result already is left alone; the full QC (qc_session_start, or the QC panel) reviews these regions. Changes Plexora's own state (reversible); returns a receipt.

force.description: Run the checks again even when their results for this image are stored.
force.title: Force

descriptor.purpose: Basic QC on an image nobody has QC'd, without a model: the Artifact Detector (tissue folds -- also ones that come or go between imaging cycles -- tears, debris, saturated pixels) written at its default thresholds as automatic, unreviewed regions, and DNA retention where the image has a DNA channel per cycle and a mask; the cells inside are excluded. A job (job_wait). An image with a QC result already is left alone; the full QC (qc_session_start, or the QC panel) reviews these regions.

tools.description: Find out-of-focus regions without a model: multi-scale gradient energy (Tenengrad) per tile of the tissue at a fixed analysis resolution, against the image's own sharpest tiles, as a 0-1 Blur Score with an automatic threshold and a whole-image blur warning, for each listed DNA channel (default the first three nuclear ones) or the ones given. A job (job_wait); a channel whose image and parameters are unchanged is reused. Nothing is written to the ROIs. Read-only.

descriptor.purpose: Find out-of-focus regions without a model: multi-scale gradient energy (Tenengrad) per tile of the tissue at a fixed analysis resolution, against the image's own sharpest tiles, as a 0-1 Blur Score with an automatic threshold and a whole-image blur warning, for each listed DNA channel (default the first three nuclear ones) or the ones given. A job (job_wait); a channel whose image and parameters are unchanged is reused. Nothing is written to the ROIs.

tools.description: Find physical artifacts without a model, across every channel: tissue folds, tears and detached tissue, debris and fibers on the glass round the section, and saturated (clipped) pixels per channel -- coarse to fine, each a snug outline with a 0-1 score, the channels it shows in and the one it shows most. A job (job_wait); reused when the image and parameters are unchanged. Needs a pixel size. Nothing is written to the ROIs. Read-only.

fold_z.description: A fold seed's least brightness over the tissue, robust SDs (default 2.5).

grow_um.description: How far the fine pass may grow an object past its coarse seed (default 150).
grow_um.title: Grow Um

pan_channels.description: Channels averaged into the pan image the objects are traced on (default 8: one nuclear per cycle, then markers evenly spaced).
pan_channels.title: Pan Channels

pixel_um.description: Microns per pixel at full resolution, when the image does not say (every size the detector uses is in microns).

expected_current_revision.description: Undo even though the store changed since this operation, provided its revision is exactly this now -- for undoing a run of writes newest first, where each undo moves the revision the next one was receipted against.

operation_id.description: The receipt's operation_id, as a write returned it or the audit log records it.

dev.description: The gateway's dev route (internal testing accounts only; billed at provider cost).

kind.description: gating: Auto Gating of the project's markers; contrast: auto contrast -- how bright each marker is drawn, no gating; qc: AutoQC of its image.

markers.description: gating, contrast: the markers (default: every marker of the table).

parallel_markers.description: gating: markers answered side by side, each lane with its own workers (default: the session's `lanes`, chosen from the panel). The gates are the serial run's; more lanes finish sooner.

resume_session.description: Continue this paused session (after a credit pause, say) instead of starting one.

start_options.description: Extra options for the session's start (the workflow's own, e.g. QC's map_cell_um).

project.description: Estimate a run of this project too.

Biology.description: The sample's biology as the user stated it (`autogate/biology.py`).

disease.description: The disease or sample type, in the user's words: 'melanoma', 'adenocarcinoma'.
disease.title: Disease

interpretation.description: The Context Interpreter's settled reading of `original` (populations of interest, corrected terms, ambiguities, scope).
interpretation.title: Interpretation

notes.description: Anything else the user said about the sample's biology.
notes.title: Notes

original.description: The user's note exactly as written, when tissue/disease/notes were interpreted from it (`plexora.ai.context`); kept beside the interpretation.
original.title: Original

tissue.description: The tissue or organ, in the user's words: 'skin', 'lymph node', 'colon'.
tissue.title: Tissue

Biology.title: Biology

chars.description: Packet JSON characters per marker, over its looks.
chars.title: Chars

images.description: Images per marker, over its looks.
images.title: Images

packets.description: Looks per marker (first look, beside a reference, candidates); confirmations are free.
packets.title: Packets

pixels.description: Image pixels per marker, over its looks.
pixels.title: Pixels

ExpressionChoice.description: Which matrix to gate on, settled before the start (`SessionOptions.expression`).

basis.description: user: the user named it (`plexora ai run --matrix/--log1p`); it is applied even over an earlier confirmed choice. inferred: a model read it from the values (`plexora.ai.harness.expression`); applied only where nothing is confirmed.
basis.title: Basis

features_log.description: Apply log1p as the values are read. Never for a matrix that is already log-transformed.
features_log.title: Features Log

ExpressionChoice.title: ExpressionChoice

absence_check.description: Before a marker's first look, show six regions of the tissue with nothing marked and ask whether any cell is clearly positive by its own stain: none in any region closes the marker with no positives (gate at the maximum), and a technical check's failed-stain verdict stands only when the regions agree. Off by default: on 12 held-out images 9 of its 17 closes were real populations of 0.5-8 % (bench GATING_GENERALISE). False: the first look comes straight away.
absence_check.title: Absence Check

absence_confirm.description: When exactly one region of an absence picture shows clear positives and the others none or few, that region is shown again close up and in its surroundings before it keeps the marker open: an edge band or a fold reads as one there, a cluster of real cells still as cells.
absence_confirm.title: Absence Confirm

agent.description: Who answers (the model, say). Earlier answers to identical packets are reused only from the same agent.
agent.title: Agent

audit_sheet.description: Show automatically accepted markers on a batched audit sheet (~70 tokens a marker).
audit_sheet.title: Audit Sheet

basic_qc.description: On an image with no QC result, run QC's model-free checks before gating it (`run_basic_qc`: folds -- also ones that come or go between imaging cycles -- tears, debris, saturation, lost nuclei; no model calls) and leave out what they find, marked automatic and unreviewed. Left out: on with engine v2, off with v1. Needs the QC plugin.
basic_qc.title: Basic Qc

biology.description: The tissue and disease the user named for this sample ("a melanoma from the skin": tissue skin, disease melanoma). A prior for references, co-expression, spatial reading and confidence -- never a rule. Left out, it is taken from the project's metadata or inferred from the panel, and marked so.

check_reading.description: How a classifier check's look is read. auto: word for a marker whose stain is fibrous (smooth muscle, vessel walls: the panel's morphology), mixed for the rest. word: one word per row; the cells the classifier flags must read as their own stain. mixed: the same words, and flagged cells read as mixed count as stained. count: the reader counts the cells in each row that carry their own stain (unmeasured).
check_reading.title: Check Reading

classifier.description: The Single Cell Classifier beside each gate. layer: after a gate is written, the classifier is trained at it and calls every cell -- the gate's call unless it is confident the other way, taking positives away more readily than adding them, and only taking them away where the marker's signal is poor; kept beside the threshold (which still decides the marker) until the user adopts it in the Thresholding panel. check: that, and where the classifier trained at a gate disagrees with it beside it, the cells it flags are shown in a look at the candidates on that side, beside cells it agrees on; the gate moves past each row the look confirms (unmeasured). off: neither.
classifier.title: Classifier

defer_parents.description: A marker whose own distribution is weak (no robust partner curve, a poorly separated mixture) waits for its children in the panel's hierarchy -- markers whose positives are a subset of its own -- and is then scored with where their positives sit (once, never after a look).
defer_parents.title: Defer Parents

delegate.description: Return the `delegate` block: how to hand the packet loop to fresh worker conversations on a cheaper or the same model (plexora/ai/delegation.py).
delegate.title: Delegate

display_check.description: Auto contrast -- how bright each marker is drawn in every look: `vision` puts a contrast grid to the model after the panel context (markers in rows, five brightnesses in columns; code picks the column) for the markers no earlier check settled -- once per image, a choice outlives the session, so an image an auto-contrast run already did is not asked again; `rule` keeps the calibration's own window (black under the background, the bright cells' structure near the top) and shows it; `off` leaves the step out. Left out: `off` with engine v2 (the setting it was measured with), `vision` with v1.
display_check.title: Display Check

engine.description: How a marker that needs a look is decided. v2 (the default): the lattice's candidate gates are competing hypotheses; blind panels of single cells, numbered and shuffled with no value or gate shown, are labelled one cell at a time, and code picks the candidate the labels support, looks again only where the leader has not beaten a rival, and closes for review with a reason when it cannot. v1: rows below, at and above the gate, then candidates beyond it, judged a row at a time. The first names, classic (v1) and candidates (v2), are accepted.
engine.title: Engine

evidence.description: delta: an evidence value this conversation was already sent comes as {as_in: packet_id} (reading_guide.as_in), and briefs carry no repeated text; full: every packet whole.
evidence.title: Evidence

expression.description: The matrix to gate on, when the user named it or a model read it from the values before the start; checked against the matrices the project has, and never log1p on values already logged.

field_um.description: The context sheet's tissue fields, microns a side: sized from each image's own pixel size (or the session's estimate of it).
field_um.title: Field Um

force.description: Start even when only some markers match an image channel: only those are gated, and the rest are skipped (skipped_no_channel) without a gate. Without it a partial match refuses to start; when no marker matches, nothing starts either way.
force.title: Force

known_guide.description: The `guide_version` of a reading guide you already hold (from an earlier session of this build): it is then not sent again.
known_guide.title: Known Guide

lanes.description: Readers answering the session at once, each its own `reader` passing `parallel` (the start's `lanes`, and its `delegate` block's). A marker never goes out beside one whose gate it reads, so the gates are the one-at-a-time run's. Default: as many as the panel's dependencies keep busy (1 for a few markers, or markers that all read each other).
lanes.title: Lanes

markers.description: Default: every marker except structural channels (DNA and the like).
markers.title: Markers

max_extensions.description: How many extra allowances one marker may get before it is flagged for review. Default from PLEXORA_GATING_MAX_EXTENSIONS.
max_extensions.title: Max Extensions

max_tier.description: 2: one look per marker; 3: + reference channels; 4: + candidate refinement; 5: + questions for the user. There is no numbers-only tier: every gate is judged on the image's pixels.
max_tier.title: Max Tier

mirror.description: Show each decision in an open viewer too.
mirror.title: Mirror

mode.description: apply: accepted gates -- and the empty gate of a failed or all-negative marker -- are written as they are decided (each receipted and undoable); propose: nothing is written until gating_session_finish(action=commit).
mode.title: Mode

observations.description: Experimental. use: what the image's contrast check saw of each marker (its pattern, dim cells seen stained, bright cells seen to be debris) goes into every look as evidence, starts the gate no higher than the dim stained cells, keeps the tissue fields away from the debris, caps confidence on a doubt, and gives a clean split with a finding a look. off: not used.
observations.title: Observations

on_limit.description: When a marker reaches its allowance of looks or candidate rounds while the evidence still says to go on: ask (the user is asked in the viewer and you are told; the marker waits, the rest goes on), extend (another allowance without asking: automated runs), stop (flag it for review). A marker is never accepted because it ran out. Default from PLEXORA_GATING_ON_LIMIT (set by `plexora mcp serve --gating-on-limit`).
on_limit.title: On Limit

overwrite_manual.description: Also re-gate markers the user set by hand (never locked or approved ones).
overwrite_manual.title: Overwrite Manual

panel_looks.description: With engine v2: the most cell panels one marker is shown before it closes for review (fewer when the leading candidate resolves first).
panel_looks.title: Panel Looks

purpose.description: gating: decide the markers' gates. contrast: auto contrast on its own (contrast_session_start) -- the set-up, the calibration and the contrast check; no marker is profiled or gated, and each closes `display_set` once its image's brightness is settled.
purpose.title: Purpose

qc.description: Which QC failures the session leaves out of every fit, sample, collage and field (the gates still apply to every cell). strict: cells QC called exclude or warn, and per marker the cells QC flagged that marker unreliable in; exclude: warn calls kept; off: QC ignored (only when the user asks, or QC is wrong). No effect on an image QC has not been run on.
qc.title: Qc

reading.description: once: the reading guide comes with the session's start and status, and packets name the entries they use; every_packet: each packet repeats the texts it needs.
reading.title: Reading

reference_image.description: Dataset scope: the image gated first (default: the one with the most cells).
reference_image.title: Reference Image

replan.description: Re-plan when markers fail: the markers left are reordered and rescored without the failed gates, accepted gates that only a failed one placed go to review, and what only biology can settle (a population that may be absent, an image whose looks keep naming the same artifact) is put to the planning task in a `replan` packet. False keeps the plan made at the start.
replan.title: Replan

reuse_answers.description: Answer a packet identical to one this agent answered before (same data, partners, code and seed) with that answer, without asking: a rerun then reaches the same gates. False asks everything afresh.
reuse_answers.title: Reuse Answers

scope.description: project: one image; dataset: every image of a dataset, the reference image first and gates carried to the rest.
scope.title: Scope

setup.description: What the start does when the project's gating set-up is not finished: a required column (cell id, coordinates, image id) not found or never confirmed, or an expression matrix its values cannot settle. ask: a column not found refuses the start, and the matrix comes to you as an expression_setup packet (put it to the user; never guess); fail: nothing starts, and the error says what is missing and how to supply it (a run with nobody to ask: `plexora ai run`); wait: the session waits in needs_setup, nothing profiled, until the user finishes the viewer's set-up form -- every column and the matrix (Plexora AI started from the viewer).
setup.title: Setup

sheets.description: trim: a context-sheet row this conversation was already shown with the same gate and fields is left out, and a whole-image check shows only the slide scale; full: every sheet whole.
sheets.title: Sheets

split_mixed.description: A look at candidates that stops at a row judged mixed and wider than two background sds gets that row split into finer candidates and looked at again, instead of the gate stopping at its edge.
split_mixed.title: Split Mixed

split_views.description: bright_rechecks: a look at candidates (a recheck of a gate) draws each cell as three panels side by side -- the DNA alone, the marker alone from the display's black to the gate at mid-grey, and the two combined (reading guide `collage_split`) -- for a marker that is not dim; a dim marker's looks stay morphology | context. off: never (unmeasured; `tiles` wins where both apply).
split_views.title: Split Views

tiles.description: Draw every look's cells as a 2 x 2 block: morphology, the context with the judged cell outlined, and one expected and one not-expected partner channel from the panel context (reading guide `collage_t2m`). Off, the looks are the two-panel cells.
tiles.title: Tiles

vision_first.description: Experimental. On a marker whose distribution says little (no valley, estimators that disagree), the looks place the gate: the first look starts at the dim cells the contrast check saw stained (else the cell share's 15% rung), the candidates are rungs by share of cells, cells below the gate seen mixed send it down, and the distribution's and spatial whole-image checks no longer fail a gate the looks placed. Pair with observations=use.
vision_first.title: Vision First

whole_image_moves.description: After a look at candidates, a whole-image check that calls the gate too low or too high sends it back to the candidates (opposite ways end in review). False: the gate stays where the rows put it, at low confidence, the disagreement noted -- the rows judged those very cells.
whole_image_moves.title: Whole Image Moves

whole_image_reopen.description: After a look at candidates, a whole-image check that calls the gate too low sends it up for one more look at the candidates above, where the first row passes even when judged mixed (two views agree); the rows still place the gate. False: it stays where the rows put it, at low confidence.
whole_image_reopen.title: Whole Image Reopen

descriptor.purpose: Gate a whole image or dataset automatically. Starts a gating session: every marker is profiled and settled deterministically where the numbers suffice (a job), and the rest become decision packets for you, one at a time, through gating_next / gating_answer.

tools.description: The session's next decision packet: one question, compact numbers, at most two small images, and the answer schema. The same packet again if it is still unanswered. Changes Plexora's own state (reversible); returns a receipt. Returns an image plus a JSON manifest of exactly what was drawn. Part of Plexora Pro; on Free it answers license_required.

parallel.description: The most packets of this session out at once, across every reader. Above 1, markers that do not depend on each other are handed out side by side; a marker still waits for the partners it is judged beside.
parallel.title: Parallel

reader.description: Who is answering, when several conversations answer one session at once (one id per conversation). Omit when you are the only one.
reader.title: Reader

rerender.description: Draw the outstanding packet's images again (same packet, same charge), in full: after a renderer change, or when you no longer hold a packet an `as_in` names.
rerender.title: Rerender

tasks.description: The tasks this reader answers (`module.task`, from its brief): it is given only their packets, and `other_tasks` when what is ready is another task's. Omit to answer every packet.
tasks.title: Tasks

wait_s.description: How long to wait for the bulk pass when nothing is ready yet.
wait_s.title: Wait S

descriptor.purpose: The session's next decision packet: one question, compact numbers, at most two small images, and the answer schema. The same packet again if it is still unanswered.

Changes Plexora's own state (reversible); returns a receipt. Returns an image plus a JSON manifest of exactly what was drawn. Part of Plexora Pro; on Free it answers license_required.

answer.description: The typed answer: `kind` plus the fields the packet's answer_schema lists.
answer.title: Answer

include_next.description: Return the next packet with the outcome, saving a gating_next call.
include_next.title: Include Next

model.description: The model you are running on, as your client names it: recorded with the answer, so the session can show which model answered each task.
model.title: Model

parallel.description: The most packets of this session out at once, across every reader. Above 1, markers that do not depend on each other are handed out side by side; a marker still waits for the partners it is judged beside.
parallel.title: Parallel

reader.description: Who is answering, when several conversations answer one session at once (one id per conversation). Omit when you are the only one.
reader.title: Reader

tasks.description: The tasks this reader answers (`module.task`, from its brief): it is given only their packets, and `other_tasks` when what is ready is another task's. Omit to answer every packet.
tasks.title: Tasks

descriptor.purpose: Answer the outstanding packet with a typed judgement; the server moves the marker on (and writes its gate when it is decided) and returns the next packet.

tools.description: A gating session's units (state, confidence, gate), what it has spent, its open questions, mirroring; or the recent sessions. Can pause or resume it. Read-only. Part of Plexora Pro; on Free it answers license_required.

known_guide.description: The `guide_version` you hold: the reading guide is then not sent again.
known_guide.title: Known Guide

limits.description: Answers to the session's limit questions (`requests` of a `waiting_for_user` result), by marker: `continue` grants another allowance, `stop` flags the marker for manual review. Pass the user's answer, not your own guess.
limits.title: Limits

replay_mirror.description: With reattach_viewer: show the packet out in the viewer now, not at the next packet.
replay_mirror.title: Replay Mirror

view_id.description: With reattach_viewer: the tab to mirror into (defaults to the one mirrored before).
view_id.title: View Id

descriptor.purpose: A gating session's units (state, confidence, gate), what it has spent, its open questions, mirroring; or the recent sessions. Can pause or resume it.

tools.description: Finish a gating session: close it, commit a propose-mode session's gates, cancel its bulk pass, or roll back every gate it wrote. Changes Plexora's own state (reversible); returns a receipt. Part of Plexora Pro; on Free it answers license_required.

action.description: close: end the session (writes stay; a marker not yet settled is written at the best gate it reached, for review; a session the user stopped in the viewer is cancelled); commit: write a propose-mode session's accepted gates and empty gates; cancel: stop the bulk pass (writes stay); rollback: undo every write the session made, newest first.
action.title: Action

descriptor.purpose: Finish a gating session: close it, commit a propose-mode session's gates, cancel its bulk pass, or roll back every gate it wrote.

tools.description: The review report of a gating session, HTML and/or PDF: per marker the final gate, the GMM proposal, confidence, flags, the distribution and the near-gate cells; for a dataset the spread across images. Read-only. Part of Plexora Pro; on Free it answers license_required.

descriptor.purpose: The review report of a gating session, HTML and/or PDF: per marker the final gate, the GMM proposal, confidence, flags, the distribution and the near-gate cells; for a dataset the spread across images.

tools.description: Render a gate check per field: A the raw marker, B the marker over nuclear grey with outlines and the gate's positive cells in magenta, C where the field's cells fall on the whole distribution -- with counts and the borderline cells by id. For judging a gate by eye. Read-only. Returns an image plus a JSON manifest of exactly what was drawn. Part of Plexora Pro; on Free it answers license_required.

classes.description: Which kinds of field to pick.
classes.title: Classes

context_marker.description: A second channel drawn in cyan in panel B, e.g. a lineage marker.
context_marker.title: Context Marker

field_size_px.description: Field side in pixels (default: the preset's pixel fallback, when it is not).
field_size_px.title: Field Size Px

field_size_um.description: Field side in microns (default: the marker-validation preset's, when the image is calibrated).
field_size_um.title: Field Size Um

fields.description: Fields from `sample_gate_validation_regions` (each with `bounds`); sampled here when omitted.
fields.title: Fields

low.description: Gate to check (default: the stored one).
low.title: Low

marker.description: A marker column, as `list_markers` names it.
marker.title: Marker

qc.description: Which QC failures to leave out of this estimate, sample or picture (the gate itself always applies to every cell). strict (the default): cells QC called exclude or warn, and for this marker the cells QC flagged it unreliable in; exclude: warn calls kept; off: QC ignored -- only when the user asks, or QC is suspected wrong. Inside a gating session the session's own setting applies. No effect where QC was never run.
qc.title: Qc

descriptor.purpose: Render a gate check per field: A the raw marker, B the marker over nuclear grey with outlines and the gate's positive cells in magenta, C where the field's cells fall on the whole distribution -- with counts and the borderline cells by id. For judging a gate by eye.

tools.description: Quality-control an image automatically. Starts a QC session: every channel is scanned and candidate artifacts found deterministically (a job); you then audit every channel at a glance and judge the candidates, one packet at a time, through qc_next / qc_answer. Confirmed artifacts become ROIs, traced to the artifact's own pixels inside the outline you judged; cells get pass/fail. Changes Plexora's own state (reversible); returns a receipt. Part of Plexora Pro; on Free it answers license_required.

images.description: Images per candidate, over its looks.
images.title: Images

packets.description: Looks per candidate (confirm, localise, grid); the audit and scope are free.
packets.title: Packets

pixels.description: Image pixels per candidate, over its looks.
pixels.title: Pixels

QCChecks.description:
The image checks a session runs first. Each scores the tissue on its
own grid; the session shows you places sampled across each score's
distribution (`score_review`) and turns what you confirm into snug
regions and cell calls. A check that cannot run here is skipped and
says why.

artifacts.description: The Artifact Detector: folds, tears, debris and saturation across every channel, one review per category (supersedes the scan's saturation detector).
artifacts.title: Artifacts

blur.description: Blur QC on the nuclear channels, or on every channel when none is recognisable by name (supersedes the scan's focus detector).
blur.title: Blur

blur_channels.description: The channels Blur QC scores (default: the session's nuclear channels, else every channel).
blur_channels.title: Blur Channels

max_pixels.description: Skip Segmentation QC on an image of more full-resolution pixels than this.
max_pixels.title: Max Pixels

registration.description: Registration Check of every nuclear channel against the reference (supersedes the scan's registration detector). Not run, and said so in the report, when fewer than two DNA channels are recognisable by name.
registration.title: Registration

segmentation.description: Segmentation QC, when the project has a mask: where too large, too small and irregular cells cluster (under/over-segmentation is reported, not outlined).
segmentation.title: Segmentation

visual.description: The visual pass: after the checks are reviewed, one look at the whole tissue in four views (the brightest DNA across cycles, first against last cycle, the mean of the channels, where channels agree) on which you outline the large, obvious artifacts the detectors missed with segment_qc_roi (session_id). Needs magic select; skipped and said so otherwise.
visual.title: Visual

QCChecks.title: QCChecks

agent.description: Who answers (the model, say). Earlier answers to identical packets are reused only from the same agent.
agent.title: Agent

background_roi.description: Write the glass outside the feathered tissue as one "QC: Background" ROI (apply mode). Its cells are noted `background`, never excluded unless the user renames or approves it so.
background_roi.title: Background Roi

channels.description: Default: every channel of the image.
channels.title: Channels

checks.description: The image checks run first (blur, registration, segmentation): their scores find the problems, you judge sampled places. Default from PLEXORA_QC_CHECKS (all).

custom_thresholds.description: With strictness=custom: keys of the strictness table, each within the lenient..strict band.
custom_thresholds.title: Custom Thresholds

known_guide.description: The `guide_version` of a reading guide you already hold: it is then not sent again.
known_guide.title: Known Guide

map_cell_um.description: The scan's map cell, microns a side (default 50).
map_cell_um.title: Map Cell Um

mirror.description: Show each decision in an open viewer too. Default (null): on when one Plexora tab is open to drive (the one showing this image, else the only one), off otherwise -- the start result's `mirror.reason` says why. true: ask for it (and say why it cannot be); false: never.
mirror.title: Mirror

mode.description: apply: confirmed regions are written as ROIs as they are decided (each receipted and undoable); propose: nothing is written until qc_session_finish(action=commit).
mode.title: Mode

on_limit.description: When a candidate reaches its allowance while the evidence still says to go on: ask the user, extend, or stop (manual review). Default from PLEXORA_QC_ON_LIMIT.
on_limit.title: On Limit

reading.description: once: the reading guide comes with the start and status; every_packet: each packet repeats the texts it needs.
reading.title: Reading

refine.description: Trace each confirmed artifact's own pixels inside the outline you judged, and write that (the outline is where to look; normal tissue inside it is kept). false: write the outline itself. Default from PLEXORA_QC_REFINE (on).
refine.title: Refine

refine_margin_um.description: The margin grown round a traced artifact, microns (default: the class's own, 3-10).
refine_margin_um.title: Refine Margin Um

reuse_answers.description: Answer a packet identical to one this agent answered before with that answer, without asking.
reuse_answers.title: Reuse Answers

scope.description: One image (a dataset scope comes later).
scope.title: Scope

strictness.description: How readily a confirmed artifact excludes cells. Changing it later re-derives every call without asking again.
strictness.title: Strictness

descriptor.purpose: Quality-control an image automatically. Starts a QC session: every channel is scanned and candidate artifacts found deterministically (a job); you then audit every channel at a glance and judge the candidates, one packet at a time, through qc_next / qc_answer. Confirmed artifacts become ROIs, traced to the artifact's own pixels inside the outline you judged; cells get pass/fail.

tools.description: The QC session's next decision packet: one question, compact numbers, at most two images, and the answer schema. The same packet again if it is still unanswered. Changes Plexora's own state (reversible); returns a receipt. Returns an image plus a JSON manifest of exactly what was drawn. Part of Plexora Pro; on Free it answers license_required.

reader.description: Who is answering, when several conversations answer one session (one id per conversation, from a worker's brief). Omit when you are the only one.
reader.title: Reader

rerender.description: Draw the outstanding packet's images again (same packet, same charge).
rerender.title: Rerender

tasks.description: The tasks this reader answers (`module.task`, from its brief): it is given only their packets, and `other_tasks` when what is ready is another task's. Omit to answer every packet.
tasks.title: Tasks

wait_s.description: How long to wait for the bulk pass when nothing is ready yet (at most 30; call again for longer).
wait_s.title: Wait S

descriptor.purpose: The QC session's next decision packet: one question, compact numbers, at most two images, and the answer schema. The same packet again if it is still unanswered.

tools.description: Answer the outstanding QC packet with a typed judgement; the server moves the channel or region on (writing its ROI when it is decided) and returns the next packet. Changes Plexora's own state (reversible); returns a receipt. Returns an image plus a JSON manifest of exactly what was drawn. Part of Plexora Pro; on Free it answers license_required.

answer.description: The typed answer: `kind` plus the fields the packet's answer_schema lists.
answer.title: Answer

include_next.description: Return the next packet with the outcome, saving a next call.
include_next.title: Include Next

model.description: The model you are running on, as your client names it: recorded with the answer, so the session can show which model answered each task.
model.title: Model

reader.description: Who is answering, when several conversations answer one session (one id per conversation, from a worker's brief). Omit when you are the only one.
reader.title: Reader

tasks.description: The tasks this reader answers (`module.task`, from its brief): it is given only their packets, and `other_tasks` when what is ready is another task's. Omit to answer every packet.
tasks.title: Tasks

descriptor.purpose: Answer the outstanding QC packet with a typed judgement; the server moves the channel or region on (writing its ROI when it is decided) and returns the next packet.

tools.description: A QC session's units (channels, candidate regions, checks), what it has spent, its limit questions, mirroring; or the recent sessions. Can pause or resume it. Read-only. Part of Plexora Pro; on Free it answers license_required.

detail.description: brief: the units list capped (with a count of the rest), the residual as its top rows plus totals, no strictness table or vocabulary; full: all of it.
detail.title: Detail

known_guide.description: The `guide_version` you hold: the reading guide is then not sent again.
known_guide.title: Known Guide

limits.description: Answers to the session's limit questions (`requests` of a `waiting_for_user` result), by unit: `continue` grants another allowance, `stop` flags it for manual review. Pass the user's answer, not your own guess.
limits.title: Limits

replay_mirror.description: With reattach_viewer: show the packet out in the viewer now, not at the next packet.
replay_mirror.title: Replay Mirror

units.description: open: list only the units still to settle and those left for a person (the counts cover the rest); all: every unit.
units.title: Units

view_id.description: With reattach_viewer: the tab to mirror into (defaults to the one mirrored before).
view_id.title: View Id

descriptor.purpose: A QC session's units (channels, candidate regions, checks), what it has spent, its limit questions, mirroring; or the recent sessions. Can pause or resume it.

tools.description: Finish a QC session: close it (its result becomes the project's active QC), commit a propose-mode session's regions, cancel its scan, or roll back every region it wrote. Changes Plexora's own state (reversible); returns a receipt. Part of Plexora Pro; on Free it answers license_required.

action.description: close: end the session (writes stay; a session the user stopped in the viewer is cancelled); commit: write a propose-mode session's results; cancel: stop the bulk pass (writes stay); rollback: undo every write the session made, newest first.
action.title: Action

units.description: open: list only the units still to settle and those left for a person (the counts cover the rest); all: every unit.
units.title: Units

descriptor.purpose: Finish a QC session: close it (its result becomes the project's active QC), commit a propose-mode session's regions, cancel its scan, or roll back every region it wrote.

tools.description: The QC report, HTML and/or PDF: every channel, every region with its class and action, the excluded tissue and cells with their denominators, the provenance. Read-only. Part of Plexora Pro; on Free it answers license_required.

session_id.description: A session; or give `project` for its active result.
session_id.title: Session Id

descriptor.purpose: The QC report, HTML and/or PDF: every channel, every region with its class and action, the excluded tissue and cells with their denominators, the provenance.

tools.description: A channel audit sheet: up to eight channels, whole tissue, at the project's calibrated windows, beside the nuclear stain. Read-only. Returns an image plus a JSON manifest of exactly what was drawn. Part of Plexora Pro; on Free it answers license_required.

channels.title: Channels
